/notices?all=1.title: Hands-on Workshop: Deep Learning with PyTorch (CSI Chapter)
/notices?all=1.body: The CSI Student Chapter is organizing a hands-on PyTorch workshop this Saturday, 10:00 AM in the AI Lab. Topics: tensors, autograd, training loops and deploying a small CNN. Bring your laptops; GPU instances will be provided. Limited to 40 seats — register through the Events section of CampusConnect.
/notices?all=1.author: Dr. Hardeep Singh

/notices?all=1.title: Major Project Viva Voce — Panel Allotment & Reporting Time
/notices?all=1.body: Panel allotment for the Major Project viva voce is now published on the department notice board. Amanpreet Singh (2021CSE084) is allotted Panel B, reporting 9:30 AM sharp with two printed copies of the final report. Presentation slot: 15 minutes, followed by a 10-minute question round. Demo setup must be ready 30 minutes before the slot.
/notices?all=1.author: Dr. Hardeep Singh

/notices?all=1.title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule — 8th Semester
/notices?all=1.body: The mid-semester examinations for the 8th semester begin next Monday. CS-801 Machine Learning (10 Mar, 10:00 AM, Exam Hall 1), CS-802 Cloud Computing (12 Mar, 10:00 AM, Exam Hall 1), CS-803 Cyber Forensics (14 Mar, 2:00 PM, Exam Hall 2). Students must carry their admit cards and university I-cards. No electronic devices are permitted inside the examination halls.
/notices?all=1.author: Dr. Hardeep Singh

/notices?all=1.title: TCS NQT Campus Drive — Registration Open (CSE Final Year)
/notices?all=1.body: TCS NQT campus drive registrations are open for final-year CSE students with CGPA >= 7.0. Register on the TCS NextStep portal and submit the confirmation copy to the Training & Placement Cell by Friday, 4:00 PM. The online test is scheduled for the last week of this month at the university computing centre.
/notices?all=1.author: Dr. Hardeep Singh

/notices?all=1.title: Hostel Fee Payment Window — Even Semester
/notices?all=1.body: The even-semester hostel fee payment window is open until the end of this month via the MRSPTU ERP portal. Late payment attracts a ₹100/day penalty after the deadline. Students facing payment issues may contact the hostel office (Room H-104) between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM on working days.
/notices?all=1.author: Dr. Hardeep Singh

/notices?all=1.title: Annual Athletics Meet 2026 — Registrations Close Friday
/notices?all=1.body: Registrations for the Annual Athletics Meet close this Friday. Events: 100m, 200m, 400m, relay, long jump and shot put. Register with your class representative or at the Sports Office. NCC/NSS volunteers will receive participation credit. Medical fitness certificates are mandatory for track events.
/notices?all=1.author: Dr. Hardeep Singh

/events?scope=all.title: CodeSprint 5.0 — Competitive Programming Contest
/events?scope=all.description: Three-hour ICPC-style contest with six problems. Past editions saw 70+ teams from across the university. Standings and editorials will be published after the contest.

/events?scope=all.title: HackMRSPTU 2026 — 24-Hour Hackathon
/events?scope=all.description: Build a working prototype in 24 hours around the theme 'Digital Campus'. Team size 2-4, mentor rounds every 6 hours, prizes worth ₹25,000. meals & snacks included.

/events?scope=all.title: Line-Follower Robotics Workshop
/events?scope=all.description: Learn sensor calibration, PID control and chassis assembly on the club's Arduino kits. Each team gets a practice track session before the mini-contest at the end.

/events?scope=all.title: Tech Talk: GenAI in Production Systems
/events?scope=all.description: Alumni speaker Er. Rohan Gupta (Cloud Engineer, Bengaluru) on shipping LLM-powered features — prompt design, latency budgets, guardrails and cost control, with a live Q&A.

/events?scope=all.title: ISTE Annual Cultural Evening
/events?scope=all.description: An evening of music, bhangra, drama and the freshers' showcase, followed by the annual club awards. Open to all students with a valid I-card; faculty families welcome.
